name: Sable Founding Gala — The Corponation Centenary Ball
creator: Sable Charter Authority / Meridian Corponation Consortium
description: The most exclusive annual event in Meridian 88, the Sable Founding Gala commemorates the signing of the Sable Charter — the legal instrument that formalized corponation sovereignty within the city — with a black-tie ceremony, curated neural-experience installation, and invitation-only dinner for the city's two hundred most powerful figures. The Gala rotates between the private estates of the five founding corponation families, and attendance is considered a marker of genuine Tier 5 standing rather than merely Tier 5 wealth.
medium: physical attendance (invitation only), classified neural archive, no public broadcast
cultural_impact: The Sable Founding Gala is where the actual governance decisions of Meridian 88 are made between courses — its guest list and seating arrangements are studied obsessively by political analysts and intelligence operatives as a map of real power.
controversy: The Gala has never acknowledged the Sable Charter's displacement of approximately 400,000 Shelf residents during its implementation; an annual protest called 'The Counter-Charter' assembles outside whatever estate hosts the event.
story_hooks: A catering staff member working the Gala under a false identity is actually a journalist who has spent three years building a cover — and tonight she's going to finally hear something she can prove.
An invitation to the Sable Founding Gala arrives for a Shelf community organizer — not forged, genuinely issued — and the reason why is far more dangerous than the obvious explanation.

The 2226 Gala's neural-experience installation was designed by an artist who encoded a detailed record of Sable Charter atrocities into the aesthetic data — and no one realized until the guests were already inside it.
